content.short: Kiln is an enterprise-grade staking-as-a-service platform providing secure and non-custodial staking solutions.
content.description: Kiln is a leading enterprise-grade staking platform, providing secure and transparent staking-as-a-service for institutional and retail participants. The platform manages billions in staked assets across major networks including Ethereum, Solana, and Polygon, serving as the primary staking partner for wallets like Ledger and exchanges like Coinbase. Fully non-custodial and SOC 2 certified, Kiln ensures users maintain full control over assets while handled by professional validator infrastructure. It optimizes performance with reporting tools, empowering participants to stake with confidence.
content.meta: Kiln provides enterprise-grade, non-custodial staking solutions across multiple blockchains. Discover Kiln and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3.
